reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to S-Miles Home
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for the existing account. Your plant, entities and history are retained.

user.title: Connect to S-Miles Home
user.description: Sign in with your S-Miles Home account, then choose a plant.

select_station.title: Select your plant
select_station.description: Choose a plant by its name and station ID. You can also type a numeric station ID directly into the dropdown. Do not use an inverter serial number.

manual_station.title: Enter your station ID
manual_station.description: Enter the numeric station ID of your plant. In S-Miles Cloud, select your plant and check the URL of its detail page. This is not the inverter serial number.

error.invalid_station: No devices were found for this station ID. Check the number and account access.
error.discovery_failed: Could not load the plant list. You can enter the station ID manually.
error.no_stations: The account returned no plants in its list. If you know your station ID, you can enter it manually.
error.invalid_station_id: Enter a positive numeric station ID.

settings_refresh_wait.message: Wait at least 30 seconds between manual settings refreshes.

battery_setting_write_failed.message: The battery setting could not be saved: {error}

init.title: PV display
init.description: Compare the PV power sensor attributes pv and pv2 with the S-Miles Home app. Select another source only after confirming the match. Automatic preserves the existing behavior: pv2 when available, otherwise pv; zero is a valid value. This changes only the display in HA. Additional telemetry is optional and read at most every five minutes. Select the actual station timezone for daily boundaries and charts.

data.battery_temperatures: Battery temperatures (beta, one extra request every five minutes)
